name: APG-68-class radar in DCS, run by a skilled human
description: The player's F-16 radar in DCS (APG-68-DCS's 55 km detection, the same physics), run as a skilled human does: the scan narrowed on the target or a single-target lock from RWS, so a track is ready about 4 s after first detection instead of the stick pilot's 15-20 s in wide TWS (SIM_REV 22).

sources.MAX_RANGE: DCS: first bugged track 35-72 km (median about 47) in 20-22 October fights; 55 km ±15% spans 47-63
sources.REF_RCS_M2: set equal to the F-16's RCS, so F-16 targets are detected at MAX_RANGE
sources.ACQUIRE_S: estimate: a few scan frames of a narrowed TWS or an RWS search then a single-target lock; not measured in DCS yet
